coverage_broad.explantion: Response a touches on a wider set of dimensions—including racial, gender, mental‑health, and age disparities; operational and psychological pressures on officers; legal outcomes; and international comparisons—whereas response b focuses mainly on the statistical definition of "innocent" as "unarmed" and the legal justification process.
